summary: Your landlord says you owe $1,450 in rent. If you do not pay or move out in 14 days, they can go to court to evict you.

deadlines.what: Pay the rent you owe or move out
deadlines.sourceQuote: You are required to pay the full amount of $1,450.00 or vacate the premises within fourteen (14) days of service of this notice.

steps: Do not ignore this letter. You still have rights.
Call a free legal aid office today to ask for help.
If you can pay, pay the full amount and get a written receipt.
If you cannot pay, ask about emergency rent help right away.
Keep this letter and all receipts in a safe place.
